rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for an activity, experience, or day that is enjoyable.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jau4 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 waan2

rows.note: Use this when the focus is on the happiness or good feelings the experience gives someone.

example.english: Going on a trip with friends is really enjoyable.
example.traditional: 同朋友一齊去旅行真係好開心。
example.jyutping: tung4 pang4 jau5 jat1 cai4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 zan1 hai6 hou2 hoi1 sam1

rows.note: Use this for something enjoyable to watch or read, such as a film, show, or book.

example.english: This movie is really enjoyable to watch.
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 tai2

rows.note: Use this when the enjoyment is especially satisfying, absorbing, or exciting.

example.english: Playing such an intense game is really enjoyable.
example.traditional: 打機打到咁激，真係過癮。
example.jyutping: daa2 gei1 daa2 dou3 gam3 gik1 zan1 hai6 gwo3 jan5
